description: Authorizes a non-bank lender's loan disbursement instruction to a bank only when the loan account is approved, the beneficiary is on that loan's record, the amount is within the per-transaction limit, and the lender's disbursement activity is within its aggregate velocity limit. Every authorization also needs a signed approval from a trusted person for this loan account, covering this amount, in signals.approvalArtifact with humanApproved true. The other signals can only refuse, never authorize on their own.

unboundSignalReasons.loanAccountApproved: Result of checking the loan account against the lender's approved loan records; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.beneficiaryAllowed: Result of checking the payee against the beneficiary list recorded on the approved loan; not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.
unboundSignalReasons.withinDisbursementLimit: Result of comparing the amount against the per-transaction disbursement limit for this lender; computed independently of the Intent.
unboundSignalReasons.withinAggregateVelocityLimit: Result of an independent check of the lender's disbursements over a rolling window (count and total); not expressible via the Intent's target/parameters.

outcome.reason: Loan disbursement authorized. Loan account, beneficiary, per-transaction limit and aggregate velocity were satisfied, with a verified human approval.
Loan disbursement rejected because the loan account is not an approved loan record.
Loan disbursement rejected because the beneficiary is not recorded on the approved loan.
Loan disbursement rejected because the amount exceeds the per-transaction disbursement limit.
Loan disbursement rejected because the lender exceeded its aggregate disbursement velocity over the rolling window.
Loan disbursement rejected because the amount must be greater than zero.
Loan disbursement rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
